units.source_text: 由于车上带下来的暖气尚未完全从岛村身上消散，岛村还没有感受到外面的真正寒冷。

en.t: Because the warmth he had brought from the train had not yet completely faded from Shimamura's body, he still had not felt the true cold outside.

units.source_text: 他是第一次遇上这雪国的冬天，一上来就被当地人的打扮吓住了。

en.t: It was his first time facing winter in this snow country, and the moment he arrived he was startled by how the local people were dressed.
